title: Used furniture marketplace with delivery
summary: Buy and sell used furniture with delivery handled.
whyTempting: Furniture is bulky and moving it is the real pain.
whyItFails: Logistics costs. Delivery costs exceed item value. Inventory quality. Items vary wildly. Free alternatives. Facebook Marketplace and Gumtree.
whatWouldChange: Pooled logistics with existing delivery networks.

attempts.notes: Handled appraisal, pickup and delivery of secondhand furniture and kept 50% of each sale.

reasons.detail: Logistics costs: Delivery costs exceed item value.
Free alternatives: Facebook Marketplace and Gumtree.
